description.narrative: The general objective is to help improve citizen security and reduce indices of insecurity and violence in the "Regin del Valle de Sula" (RVS). This will be achieved through the institutional strengthening and the comprehensive prevention actions. The principal beneficiaries are young adults (10 to 25 years old), citizens of the RVS, which are considered by their socioeconomic conditions as vulnerable and at risk, or as young people who have broken the law.
